summary: acer aspire 7 gaming laptop is experiencing freezing and blue screen of death (BSOD) issues, as well as failure to detect the RTX 2050 graphics card.
detected_fault: nvlddmkm error in video_dxgkrnl_fatal_error after analyzing minidump file using Windbg
suggested_solution: Install latest available NVIDIA driver version and check for BIOS updates, run stress test to identify thermal or hardware issues
